summary: Compare ISO 37001 editions, plan ABMS updates, and prepare for the PECB ISO 37001:2025 Transition exam.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who maintain, update, or oversee an ISO 37001 anti-bribery management system and need to assess the 2025 edition.
prerequisites: You need a general understanding of anti-bribery concepts and ISO 37001 requirements to attend this course.
